_comment: Daily Pinterest drip (owner-approved 16 Oct 2026). Each item is one pin VARIANT of a kit/guide page: its own headline, angle, layout and palette, its own 1000x1500 image (dist/pins/<id>.png, built by scripts/build_pin_images.mjs from the page's kit preview art), and a releaseDate (America/Chicago). /pinfeed.xml (functions/pinfeed.xml.js, request time) shows the 11 launch items in pinfeed.json plus every item with releaseDate <= today, newest MAX_FEED_ITEMS. PINS_PER_DAY is the one knob for the drip rate. scripts/pinterest/refill_queue.mjs appends the next batch when fewer than REFILL_THRESHOLD remain unreleased (daily, .github/workflows/pinterest-refill.yml). Guarded by validate:pinterest-drip.
